key_concepts: The lithosphere is the solid part of Earth.
The lithosphere includes the crust and the upper mantle.
The crust is the upper part of the lithosphere.
The asthenosphere and lower mantle are not part of the lithosphere.
The lithosphere is divided into pieces called plates.
Earth has larger plates and smaller plates.
Major plates include the Eurasian, North American, Pacific, African, Antarctic, Australian
Smaller plates include the Caribbean, Juan de Fuca, Philippine, Arabian, Indian, Cocos, Na
